title: Bow zoom limit 2 + L2 vs aiming
intro: Reset Scripts first (CameraDistance 2.7.1, DPC 0.9.5). The zoom-limit box should still be ticked. Press End.

steps.text: The main pawn 5-10 m to one side, in front: aim the bow. Does the view widen to keep him in? Press End
Keep aiming while the main pawn runs across in front. Smooth? Press End
Stop aiming. Does the view go back to normal? Press End
Controller: HOLD L2 (the main pawn blocks). Arisen: aim with right mouse. Can he aim now? Press End
Controller only: tap R1, R2, Cross. The ARISEN must NOT attack or jump. Did he? Press End

probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active
probes.pscr: local p=H.pawn(0):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.ascr: local p=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.aim: local a=H.arisen(); local h=a:call('get_Human'); return tostring(a:call('get_IsAim'))..'/'..tostring(a:call('get_IsShootAim'))..'/'..tostring(h and h:call('get_IsAim'))
probes.ctrl: local mc=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController',0); local c=mc:call('get_CurrentCameraController'); return c and (c:get_type_definition():get_name()..' '..tostring(c:call('get_BaseDistance'))) or 'nil'
